name: Sinopec Shanghai Petrochemical Company Limited
summary: Sinopec Shanghai Petrochemical Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells petroleum and chemical products in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through three segments: Refined Products, Chemical Products, and Petrochemical Products Trading.
